top_signals.title: Trump says he discussed Jensen Huang with Xi, apparently contradicting Bessent
top_signals.summary: Trump said he discussed Jensen Huang with China's Xi, hours after Bessent said the ousted Nvidia CEO didn't come up in the talks.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
